blocks.text: Customer feedback boards, roadmaps, and changelogs in one place

Featurebase solves a problem every product team faces: turning scattered customer feedback into a prioritized development roadmap. Instead of feedback living in support tickets, Slack messages, and spreadsheets, Featurebase gives it a structured home where users can submit ideas, vote on priorities, and track progress.

The public roadmap feature builds transparency with your user base. Customers can see what is planned, in progress, and shipped - reducing "when will you build X?" support tickets and building trust in your product direction.

Changelogs close the loop. When you ship a feature that users requested, Featurebase notifies everyone who voted for it. This feedback-to-delivery cycle creates a community of engaged users who feel heard and invested in your product.
Public or private boards where users submit and discuss ideas
Let users vote on features to surface community priorities
Transparent view of planned, in-progress, and completed work
Beautiful product update announcements with email notifications
Embed feedback collection and changelog directly in your product
Sync with Linear, Jira, GitHub, Slack, and Intercom
Featurebase replaces the chaotic process of collecting and prioritizing feedback with a structured system that keeps users engaged and product teams focused on what matters most.
Our team can integrate Featurebase into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
